game_concept: A racing platformer set in Snowy Hold – Frosted Chapel, a frosted chapel: the sled courier must handle snow wraiths while practicing functions. Core idea – Scope Sanctuary: Distinguish local from global variables to keep warm lanterns safe from snow wraiths.
theme: Snowy Hold – Frosted Chapel: a frosted chapel
core_gameplay_loop: In Frosted Chapel, repeat each round: Distinguish local from global variables to keep warm lanterns safe from snow wraiths. Each round the rival advances, and solving the step moves the sled courier ahead. Then check the scope_safe value and advance.
player_objective: Beat a rival AI to the sleigh by solving code steps involving scope_safe that move the sled courier forward.
controls: Keyboard: arrow keys move the hero, SPACE performs the main action, ENTER runs the code.
win_condition: Player progress reaches 100% before the rival does (rival speed 0.8).
lose_condition: The rival reaches the sleigh first, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 6 – Functions | Level 1 (intro tier): Scope Sanctuary
assets_style: cozy pixel-art snow town: icy blue rooftops, frosted pines, warm lantern glow; flat Kenney-style sprites; soft bells, wind howls and cozy hearth crackle
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Scope Sanctuary' (Week 6 slot 7), mission type 'Rival Race', and setting 'Frosted Chapel'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Snowy Hold
region.mood: soft bells, wind howls and cozy hearth crackle

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how scope_safe changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against snow wraiths in Frosted Chapel.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Player progress reaches 100% before the rival does (rival speed 0.8).
